symptom: After the #832 pluggable patch, re-running `describe page WorkflowCommons.TaskInbox` (and TaskDashboard) unchanged on ako/TestApp still reported "Replaced page" and left 4 Forms$OpenUserTaskClientAction where there had been 6: the link button in the last column of the two task grids that opens the task became a Forms$NoAction. check, exec and mx check (3 errors, the same as the untouched copy) were all clean. A stored "Show workflow admin page" or "Call workflow" on any button went the same way, and a `complete task` with ClosePage or Commit false came back true
cause: describe had no case for Forms$OpenUserTaskClientAction, Forms$OpenWorkflowClientAction or Forms$CallWorkflowClientAction, so it printed no Action; a classic widget is rebuilt from the statement, and an absent Action builds a Forms$NoAction. The grid's own row click survived only because the pluggable patch keeps a property both builds agree on; the column content (a Widgets property) always takes the statement's build. `complete task` hard-coded ClosePage and Commit true and describe printed neither
file: mdl/grammar/domains/MDLPage.g4 (actionExprV3: open user task / open workflow / call workflow; actionSettingV3 value is a qualifiedName); mdl/visitor/visitor_action_settings.go (per-kind keys, requireOpenWorkflowPage); mdl/executor/cmd_pages_builder_v3.go, page_action_settings.go, page_workflow_actions.go; mdl/executor/cmd_pages_describe_output.go, cmd_pages_describe_action_settings.go; mdl/backend/modelsdk/widget_write.go (clientActionToGen); sdk/pages/pages_widgets_action.go
fix: Spell the actions, in the words the microflow actions already use: `open user task [with (AssignOnOpen, OpenWhenAssigned)]`, `open workflow with (DefaultPage: M.P)`, `call workflow M.WF [with (ClosePage, Confirmation…)]`, and ClosePage/Commit settings on `complete task`. describe prints each and only the settings that differ from a new action. Spelling beat a carry: a carry would keep the action on a rewrite but not let anyone write an inbox, and every page action that MDL cannot say is one more carry to get wrong
insight: The class is 'describe prints nothing for an action type' — grep renderClientActionBaseMDL's `default: return ""` against modelsdk/gen/pages' *ClientAction types to find the rest (SyncClientAction and CancelSynchronizationClientAction are still unspelled). mx check is no witness here: a NoAction is legal, and the fixed and fault-forced TestApp copies both report the control's 3 errors; count the action $Types in `bson dump` before and after instead. Measure the property set with Mendix rather than guessing: exec into a fresh 11.13.0 app, `mx convert -p` a copy, and compare the action elements key-sorted — identical for all 8, so the sets are Studio Pro's. That run also found what no doc says: "Show workflow admin page" REQUIRES its page (CE1834 'The Page property is required'), so DefaultPage is mandatory and a stored page-less one describes as a NOT re-executable note; placing open user task / open workflow outside a System.WorkflowUserTask / System.Workflow data container is CE1843. Defaults come from the Model SDK constructors (AssignOnOpen true, ClosePage/Commit true); CallWorkflowClientAction.commit was deleted in 9.12 and must not be written
